cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Lost in the Process
cards.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your parcel got caught between reception and dispatch. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left it on the bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Dispatch handed it to transport without a receipt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Both departments are you. Call the bus company.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll report a failure across dispatch, transport and receipt control. They'll need to investigate all three.

mechanism: A manages the lost-parcel recovery by accepting the bus call while recruiting B to describe an impersonal handover failure.
confusable: Unlike blaming another named person, A spreads their own mistake among dispatch, transport and handover steps.
comparison: A lost object and delegated call account differ from replacement invitations checked before sending.
seedUse: D181-a bus and department fiction; S02-a adapts the recovery plan to B insistence on an actual call.
